hits.title: What you need before you register on the NHCX sandbox

reply.Text:
The ABDM developer portal documentation doesn't contain NHA phone support contact information. For direct phone contact with NHA support, I'd recommend:

1. **Visit the official NHA website** (nha.gov.in) — they should have contact details for support
2. **Check the ABDM official portal** (abdm.gov.in) — it may have support contact information
3. **Look for your sandbox provider's support** — if you're registered with a specific gateway (HIE-CM, NHCX, UHI), they may have dedicated support channels

Is there a specific ABDM integration issue I can help you with using the developer documentation?
